title: POV: You Wake Up in Pompeii, 24 Hours Before the Eruption #shorts
hook_text: POV: YOU WAKE UP IN POMPEII
description:
It's 79 AD. You wake up in Pompeii, a busy Roman city at the foot of Mount Vesuvius. In about 24 hours, it will be buried under ash. Would you have left in time?

Images are AI-generated recreations based on archaeological findings.

#pompeii #history #ancientrome #pov #lostworlds
image_style: photorealistic, cinematic film still, ancient Roman city of Pompeii in 79 AD, historically accurate, warm natural light, highly detailed, 35mm, no text, no watermark

scenes.text: You wake up in Pompeii, 79 AD. In twenty-four hours, this city will be buried alive.
scenes.image: first-person view waking up in a small Roman bedroom, painted red fresco walls, wooden bed with wool blanket, morning sunlight through a small high window

scenes.text: Bakers pull round loaves from stone ovens. Archaeologists will find loaves like these, turned to charcoal, two thousand years later.
scenes.image: Roman bakery interior, large brick dome oven, round bread loaves scored into eight segments, lava stone grain mills, baker in simple tunic

scenes.text: You grab lunch at a street counter. Hot food served from jars built into the stone. Roman fast food.
scenes.image: Roman thermopolium street food counter, large terracotta jars set into a marble countertop, colorful fresco on the counter, customers in tunics

scenes.text: The walls are covered in painted slogans and graffiti. People here write on everything.
scenes.image: narrow Roman street with stepping stones, walls covered in red painted Latin election slogans and scratched graffiti, shops with wooden shutters

scenes.text: Some buildings still show cracks from a massive earthquake years ago.
scenes.image: Roman workers on wooden scaffolding repairing a cracked brick and plaster building, mortar and tools, busy street below

scenes.text: Then the ground trembles. Nobody panics. Small quakes happen here all the time.
scenes.image: Roman forum with columns and citizens calmly continuing their day, slight dust falling from a column, merchants at stalls

scenes.text: Above the city, Vesuvius is green and covered in vineyards. Almost no one sees it as a threat.
scenes.image: wide view of lush green Mount Vesuvius covered in vineyards rising behind the Roman city of Pompeii, blue sky, peaceful afternoon

scenes.text: That night, you fall asleep like everyone else.
scenes.image: dark Roman bedroom at night lit by a single small oil lamp, person sleeping under a wool blanket, calm and quiet, deep shadows

scenes.text: Tomorrow, around midday, the mountain will explode. Ash and stones will rain down for hours.
scenes.image: massive dark eruption column rising from Mount Vesuvius above Pompeii, ash cloud spreading across the sky, terrified people in the street looking up

scenes.text: Most will run. Those who stay will be frozen in time. Would you have left?
scenes.image: abandoned Pompeii street covered in grey ash and pumice under a dark orange sky, eerie silence, dramatic lighting
